top1.title: 【2026-11-13】Nvidiaの暫定CEOにコレット・クレス氏、フアン氏の後任探しへ
top1.lead1: AI半導体大手Nvidiaで経営トップが交代。フアン氏の辞任を受け、CFOのクレス氏が暫定CEOに就いた。
top1.lead2: 同社は正式な後任の選定を進める。クレス氏は顧客や開発者への対応を継続し、AI分野の事業を前進させる方針を示した。

top10.title: [2026-11-13] Colette Kress named Nvidia interim CEO as search begins for Huang's successor
top10.summary: Nvidia's Huang resigned immediately as CEO and from other positions. CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO, and the company is proceeding with the selection of a permanent successor.

top10.title: [2026-11-13] Google Search adds Gemini 4 Hydrogen to improve answers to complex questions
top10.summary: Google introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen to AI Mode in Search. It improves understanding of complex questions and visual answers, with a gradual rollout to users worldwide.

top10.title: [2026-11-13] United Airlines restricts booking actions by unauthorized third-party AI
top10.summary: United Airlines is restricting unauthorized third-party AI access to booking and reservation management, citing concerns about leaked credentials, unintended purchases and violations of aviation rules.

top10.title: [2026-11-13] AI shopping assistants also suggest fake shopping sites, Podqi study finds
top10.summary: Podqi examined shopping responses from three AI systems. It found references to dangerous sites, including fake shopping sites, but the tally also includes references made as warnings.

top10.title: [2026-11-13] Norwest expands AI investment with its largest-ever $4 billion fund
top10.summary: Norwest established its largest-ever fund at $4 billion. It will expand investments in physical AI, voice AI and cybersecurity in markets including the United States, India and Israel.

top10.title: [2026-11-13] Analysis: SoftBank's equipment-related losses highlight risks of gas-fired power investment for AI
top10.summary: TechCrunch analyzed investment in power supplies for AI against the backdrop of SoftBank's power-generation equipment-related losses. It discussed the risks of gas-fired generation and the alternatives of grid connections and battery storage.

top10.title: [2026-11-13] Nectar launches AI agent handling creator discovery through outreach
top10.summary: Nectar launched Creator Agent worldwide. It supports discovering Instagram and TikTok creators, personalized outreach, partnership management and tracking campaign effectiveness.

top10.title: [2026-11-13] Maya site 'newly discovered' by AI had already been reported in an existing paper
top10.summary: A Maya archaeological site identified as unregistered by 48 AI agents had already been described in an existing paper. Researchers point out the distinction between AI identifying candidates and experts verifying them.

top10.title: [2026-11-13] Phota Labs releases AI photo app aimed at preserving personal likeness
top10.summary: Phota Labs released a free iOS photo app. The company says its proprietary technology changes composition and other aspects while preserving a person's distinctive features, and adds an invisible watermark indicating AI editing.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
